page: Microsoft Azure DC96ads_v6 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 96 vCPUs mapped across 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading and dedicated CPU allocation. Memory capacity totals 384.0 GB, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include support for advanced vector extensions such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16, alongside cryptographic acceleration instructions including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Integrated local storage is bundled with the instance, providing 3,865 GB of local solid-state storage. The instance operates without discrete graphics accelerators. In synthetic and application benchmark evaluations, the DC96ads_v6 displays top-tier multi-core computing throughput, registering 143,851.54 on stress-ng multi-core and 61,921.0 on Clang software compilation benchmarks. Vector-intensive tasks also show top-tier metrics, as evidenced by a Geekbench ray tracing score of 92,754.0. In-memory throughput is demonstrated by Redis SET performance measuring 94.19 million operations per second, while single-core metrics fall into strong percentiles.

The dense core footprint combined with substantial local NVMe storage and balanced memory enables significant operational efficiency for high-concurrency systems without requiring distinct storage attachments for intermediate scratch disks. Tradeoffs include lack of hardware virtualization nesting or GPU compute, and text processing scores remain in the average tier. Microsoft Azure DC96ads_v6 is targeted for large-scale enterprise databases, intensive software compilation pipelines, multi-threaded scientific modeling, and high-concurrency Redis caching layers.
description: Microsoft Azure DC96ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs derived from 48 physical cores on an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture with Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 384.0 GB of system memory, delivering a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU profile. The instance bundles 3,865 GB of fast local SSD storage and lacks discrete GPUs. Architectural capabilities include AVX-512 vector execution, AVX512_BF16, and hardware-accelerated cryptography. Benchmark metrics reflect top-tier multi-threaded processing power, highlighted by high scores in multi-core stress testing, Clang software build times, and ray tracing, complemented by strong Redis SET throughput of 94.19 million operations per second. The server offers strong multi-threaded resource density for organizations running heavy CI/CD pipelines, in-memory caches, distributed databases, and high-throughput enterprise workloads.
